WODEHOUSE.text: WODEHOUSE, SIR PHILIP E., K.C.B. (Creat. 1862.)—Entered the Ceylon civil service as a writer, May, 1828; promoted to be assistant colonial secretary and clerk of the executive and legislative councils, Oct. 1833; district judge of Kandy, 1840; government agent for the western province, 1843; was appointed superintendent of Honduras, 1851; in Feb. 1854, governor of British Guiana; was employed in 1858 on a special mission to the government of Venezuela; and in 1861 was appointed governor of the Cape of Good Hope; is also high commissioner in South Africa.
